name: Adrian Patchett
story: Adrian Patchett’s geospatial record spans iwi cultural mapping and later statistical geography. A 2019 Geospatial Research Institute seminar named Patchett and Sean Bragg presenting Ngāi Tahu’s use of geospatial technology and Kā Huru Manu in planning, cultural-values protection and place-name work. LINZ later lists him as the Stats NZ member of the Geospatial Capability Committee.
LINZ’s 2026 Geospatial Capability Committee material lists Adrian Patchett in Stats NZ; Geospatial Capability Committee..
